depicted_variant: Bajang sebagai pole-cat familiar yang muncul dari tabung bambu dan menerjang karena diabaikan tuannya.

visual_requirements.description: Wujud pole-cat sesuai Skeat, bukan cricket/lizard atau hantu humanoid gabungan.
Mengganggu rumah dan menyerang tuan jika kelaparan/diabaikan; aksi menerjang, tanpa aura atau possession beam.
Interior rumah dengan tabung bambu sebagai tempat menyimpan familiar.

aura: Ancaman familiar datang dari pole-cat yang mengganggu rumah dan dapat menyerang tuannya jika diabaikan (bajang-c04, bajang-c09, bajang-c07).
artistic_choices: Varian pole-cat dipilih; tidak memakai cricket/lizard/musang atau kuku panjang hantu humanoid.
Satu kepala, dua mata, empat kaki dan ekor mengikuti pole-cat biasa, warna bulu cokelat/hitam editorial.
Tidak menggambar fetus/anak/victim/injury atau counter-charm tulisan.
Tabung bambu terbuka, mangkuk susu kosong dan telur adalah properti editorial dari c03/c09; ukuran tubuh dipertahankan melalui framing close-up.
Tidak memvisualisasi penyakit sebagai cahaya atau kabut supernatural.
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mythics illustration of BAJANG, the male Malay familiar spirit usually taking POLE-CAT form in Skeat's account.
ANATOMY: exactly ONE ferocious thin POLE-CAT, one head two natural eyes four paws one long furry tail, dark brown-black coarse fur and pale muzzle, realistic pole-cat teeth, no humanoid limbs, horns or glowing eyes. [bajang-c04]
MOMENT: exploding out of an opened BAMBOO TUBE toward the viewer, mouth open in a harsh catlike mewing snarl, front claws reaching and body airborne low above floor; an empty milk bowl and an egg lie neglected behind. Familiar is turning on its master after being left hungry. No victim on screen. [bajang-c03,c04,c09]
POWER: hostile familiar disturbing the house and attacking its neglectful master, conveyed by physical lunge and claw contact only; no ghostfire, sickness beams or generic aura. [bajang-c04,c09,c07]
SCALE & CAMERA: floor-level extreme close low angle, pole-cat head and outstretched paws dominate square, body remains ordinary small-animal scale; opened bamboo tube partly behind it.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one low warm oil-lamp source out of frame, deep walnut shadows, floor dust kicked by claws.
SURFACE: ragged coarse fur, wet teeth, scratched bamboo, worn wood floor.
SETTING: dark household interior consistent with the spirit disturbing the household, bamboo storage tube. [bajang-c04,c03]
MOOD: ferocious uncanny familiar, dangerous and imposing through confrontation, never pet, cute ferret or decorative zoo portrait.

HARD CONSTRAINTS: square at least1024px; no text, lettering, glyphs, inscriptions, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, limbs or fingers; no design borrowed from films, games, anime or comics; no nudity, exposed breasts or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outlines, floating runes or energy ribbons.
reason: Tabung bambu c03 dihasilkan sebagai keranjang anyaman silinder; bukan rongga batang bambu alami yang didokumentasikan. Perlu edit targeted container saja.
